title: Decision: received Messages have deliveryState delivered
description: Base draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 (cefc217) ~L665-668 defines deliveryState pending/delivered/failed/received only from the sender's view (received = read receipt). Silent on Messages stored in the recipient's mailbox. Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-19): 'delivered' (it arrived; 'received' would claim it was read; 'pending' is meaningless on arrival). Implemented in .11.3 projection.
